quest.title: The Lost Relic
quest.description: Bao'er claims to have lost a precious relic and is now frantically searching high and low for it. Perhaps she could use a hand...

dialogues.speaker: Bao'er
dialogues.text: Wah! Where'd you come from!? How'd you sneak up so quietly...

dialogues.speaker: Bao'er
dialogues.text: Me? I'm... a researcher. I'm looking into the historical architecture and relics of the Guili Plains. Y—You can call me Bao'er.

dialogues.speaker: Bao'er
dialogues.text: I was so engrossed in my research that I've misplaced a package I carry round with me.

dialogues.speaker: Bao'er
dialogues.text: It's got an extremely rare trea... Uh, an extremely rare historical relic inside. Could you help me look for it?

response.speaker: Bao'er
response.text: Great! I think it was near here that I dropped it... or maybe a little further out. Anyway, please have a careful look.

choices.text: What does the package look like?

response.speaker: Bao'er
response.text: Y'know, just... an everyday box. Four sides, a top, and a bottom...

response.speaker: Bao'er
response.text: Why put a relic in there? Because... Having it in a box is more convenient.

response.speaker: Bao'er
response.text: I padded the box with some clothes to protect it from damage. Please, help me find it as quickly as you can.

response.speaker: Bao'er
response.text: It's, uh... It's just a very precious relic. Ugh, you wouldn't understand even if I tried to explain it.

response.speaker: Bao'er
response.text: Only an expert like me can tell its true value. Please, help me find it as quickly as you can.

talks.objective: Search for the item Bao'er lost

dialogues.text: Let me see... No, I—I don't think so... Feels too light, it's definitely not that relic inside...

dialogues.speaker: Bao'er
dialogues.text: But thanks anyway. I'll keep looking by myself.
